description: Source code for a gRPC client implementation of the OpenTelemetry trace exporter, including connection management, trace data upload, and retry logic.

classes.name: client
classes.description: Implementation of the otlptrace.Client interface for gRPC communication with the OpenTelemetry collector.

methods.name: NewClient
methods.description: Factory function to create a new gRPC trace client with optional configurations.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Establishes a gRPC connection to the collector and initializes instrumentation.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Shuts down the client, closing connections and stopping ongoing exports.

methods.name: UploadTraces
methods.description: Sends a batch of trace spans to the collector, with retry logic for transient errors.

methods.name: exportContext
methods.description: Creates a context with timeout and metadata for trace export operations.

methods.name: retryable
methods.description: Determines if an error is retryable based on gRPC status codes.

methods.name: retryableGRPCStatus
methods.description: Checks specific gRPC status codes to decide if errors are retryable.

methods.name: throttleDelay
methods.description: Extracts retry delay information from gRPC status details.

methods.name: MarshalLog
methods.description: Provides a structured log representation of the client instance.
